items.title: Bonus Hollander POTD Bill Bradley. Dollar Bill was a star at Princeton. Drafted 2nd by NY in 65, took 2 yrs as Rhodes Scholar before debuting in 67. Solid SF scoring w/16 ppg peak, 1x all-star. Fit NY system very well. Retired in 77 & later a senator from NJ. Didn't dress well.
